prompt: I just ran trade-execute on signals.json. The orchestrator crashed mid-write. Now I rerun it on the same signals.json. What happens?
expected_output: The orchestrator loads existing market_ids from orders.json. Any market already attempted is skipped (status='skipped' or 'placed' is recorded; on re-run it's already present, so no double-place). At most one order per market per tick.

assertions.name: checks_idempotency
assertions.description: Output must explain the idempotency check

assertions.name: no_double_place
assertions.description: Output must explicitly say no double-place
assertions.check: output contains ('no double' or 'not duplicated' or 'reused') AND 'order'

assertions.name: atomic_write_guarantees
assertions.description: Output must mention the atomic write that prevents partial state

assertions.name: idempotency_key
assertions.description: Output must reference the market_id as the dedup key
